verdict.reason: priors gathered from documents; nothing scored. Four rows are MEASURED sales-weighted averages for new US network equipment; the rest are regulatory targets or model inputs

law: each row is a price in a regime: its year and basis are part of the value; none should be carried to another regime without saying so
warning: network energy is mostly baseload per line. Pricing traffic kept local at an average kWh per GB would overstate the saving by a large factor; use the baseload and traffic-dependent rows, in a short-run and a long-run regime.
licences: values are facts quoted with their sources; the EU Code of Conduct is CC BY 4.0 (European Commission, Joint Research Centre)
